articles.summary: ChargePoint and travel plaza chain Onvo plan to install ultra-fast EV chargers at 12 highway locations across Pennsylvania and New York, making EV road tripping a little more convenient.

articles.title_original: Aptera announces nationwide repair network for its upcoming solar electric car
articles.title_zh: Aptera为即将上市的太阳能电动汽车宣布全国维修网络
articles.summary: Aptera has officially announced a repair network partnership which will give owners of its upcoming solar electric car access to thousands of repair shops nationwide.
